pages.title: Bird Sort
pages.creator: Zenida Studios
pages.description: Reunite matching flocks in Bird Sort. Select birds on one branch and move them to an available highlighted branch until each contains a complete matching group. Plan transfers around the remaining space so every bird can join others of its color.

pages.title: Fashion Stylist Salon Makeover
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Run a beauty service in Fashion Stylist Salon Makeover. Welcome customers with different requests and handle haircuts, styling, and skin-care treatments. Choose the appropriate salon activities to complete each visitor's look and leave them satisfied with the makeover.

pages.title: Bolts and Nuts - Sorting
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Reorganize fasteners in Bolts and Nuts - Sorting. Click nuts to unscrew and move them, considering which one must come off first. Later puzzles complicate the order, so plan your removals rather than clearing whichever nut is easiest to reach.

pages.title: SWAT Cats Shooter
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Take part in armed feline battles in SWAT Cats Shooter. Move around the battlefield, select equipment, and use your weapons against other combatants. A map helps you track the surroundings, while jumping, crouching, and reloading support the fight.

pages.title: Knife.io
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description: Throw blades at opponents in Knife.io. Move to dodge incoming attacks and choose openings for accurate throws before enemies can hit you. Play alone or with a friend in local multiplayer, unlocking additional characters as the arena contests continue.

pages.title: Pixel Blast
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Move a cannon through arcade encounters in Pixel Blast. Steer around obstacles, blast pixelated opponents, and collect bonuses and gold while working through enemy waves. Shop and appearance options let you develop the cannon as you continue toward tougher confrontations.

pages.title: Pin master: Screw puzzle quest & brain games
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Release suspended metal pieces in Pin master: Screw puzzle quest & brain games. Remove screws in an order that lets the plates fall correctly without leaving the puzzle blocked. Hints and a screw-removal aid provide assistance when another solution is difficult to find.

pages.title: Feet Doctor Urgency Care
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Treat injured patients in Feet Doctor Urgency Care. Examine their feet and use the available medical tools to work through each urgent condition. The simulation puts you in charge of completing the care sequence for the people arriving at the clinic.

pages.title: Mahjong Garden
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Clear an untimed tile board in Mahjong Garden. Select matching free pieces to remove them and expose further pairs beneath the layout. Unlock additional tile designs and backgrounds as you continue working through the game's matching puzzles.

pages.title: angry snake io
pages.creator: zedlox
pages.description: Grow a serpentine creature by eating colored orbs in angry snake io. Steer through the arena while avoiding traps and obstacles that threaten the run. A larger body and increasing speed change the handling as you try to keep the snake alive.

pages.title: Jailbreak. Roblox jumper
pages.creator: Crazy Pixel
pages.description: Cross a series of prison platforms in Jailbreak. Roblox jumper. Gather coins that support the escape while avoiding traps and gaps along the route. Guide the block-style character carefully, because a mistaken landing can end the attempt before freedom is reached.

pages.title: Strategy of war. Tanks and helicopters.
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Command ground and air units in Strategy of war. Tanks and helicopters. Develop a base, allocate resources, and send armored squads or aircraft into battle. Choose offensive and defensive tactics, capture enemy positions, and improve your forces for later missions.

pages.title: Pirates Match The Lost Treasure
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Search for pirate riches through matching puzzles in Pirates Match The Lost Treasure. Form matching groups to work through the level objectives and continue the adventure. Power-ups help with difficult boards as you progress toward finding the missing treasure.

pages.title: Monster High Spooky Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style spooky characters in Monster High Spooky Fashion. Mix clothing, eerie accessories, and makeup into individual looks for parties or other events. Compare the available options and give each character a coordinated outfit that suits the supernatural theme.

pages.title: Happy Glass Game
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Guide water into an empty cup in Happy Glass Game. Draw a supporting route so the flow reaches the glass and fills it. Eighty levels present different arrangements, and using less drawing to solve them improves your score.

pages.title: Only Up Balls
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Bounce a ball toward high rooftops in Only Up Balls. Jump between platform tracks, beginning with the introductory sections before progressing to harder courses. Play alone or with another person, using separate movement, jumping, and respawn controls for each player.

pages.title: Hawaii Match 5
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match tropical fruit and flowers in Hawaii Match 5. Meet each board's goals within a limited number of moves, making longer combinations to produce helpful boosters. Continue through island-themed stages and use those bonuses to handle more difficult collections.

pages.title: Drop Bricks Breaker
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Break targets with aimed shots in Drop Bricks Breaker. Tap to line up the launcher and send a ball toward the bricks. Choose a useful trajectory and work through the formation as the puzzle asks you to clear the remaining pieces.

pages.title: Jewel Legend Quest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Gather diamonds through matching puzzles in Jewel Legend Quest. Swap pieces into lines of at least three identical gems to clear them and meet the stage's goal. Matches of four or more reward you with explosive power-ups for difficult sections.

pages.title: Cosmic Aviator
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Pilot a craft through an ongoing tunnel in Cosmic Aviator. Steer around the twisting course's obstacles and hazards while collecting power-ups. Keep the aircraft intact and use the pickups to build a stronger score throughout the flight.

pages.title: Venetian Love Affair
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Prepare two friends for a carnival in Venetian Love Affair. Design decorative masks and pair them with Baroque dresses, jewelry, and accessories. Coordinate each character's choices into a complete fancy-dress look for the Venice celebration.

pages.title: Cooking Live - Be a Chef & Cook
pages.creator: Matryoshka Games (CY) LTD
pages.description: Restore local food businesses in Cooking Live - Be a Chef & Cook. Help Jane prepare dishes by selecting ingredients and following the recipes in order. Her journey connects restaurant cooking tasks with supporting the independent eateries she discovers while traveling.

pages.title: Color Race 3D
pages.creator: Keinax
pages.description: Build a larger fighter during a run in Color Race 3D. Gather stick figures matching your color and collect coins as you approach the finish. Reach the final boss with enough size to overcome it, steering toward the companions that strengthen your character.

pages.title: Skibidi in the Backrooms
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Search an unsettling maze for videotapes in Skibidi in the Backrooms. Use the map to plan your route while avoiding the creature wandering through the rooms. Collect the tapes quickly without allowing the enemy to spot and catch you.

pages.title: Fashion Stylist
pages.creator: Rendered Ideas
pages.description: Create themed outfits and compete against other players in Fashion Stylist. Combine clothing, accessories, and hairstyles to match each styling task. You can also judge other contestants' looks, voting on their combinations while working toward your own fashion competition results.

pages.title: My Fabulous Vintage Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Give three princesses retro-inspired looks in My Fabulous Vintage Look. Browse their wardrobes and choose a distinct outfit for each friend. Coordinate the available pieces to explore vintage fashion as they prepare their weekend styles.

pages.title: Obstacle Cross Drive Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Complete timed truck assignments in Obstacle Cross Drive Simulator. Follow arrows and on-screen hints while working through four driving modes. Each level has three requests to satisfy, with all three needed when you are aiming for the full star result.

pages.title: POLYPUZZLE
pages.creator: AlexGames!
pages.description: Place geometric pieces on a ten-by-ten board in POLYPUZZLE. Rotate them as needed and complete horizontal or vertical lines to score. Consecutive clears build combos, but the game ends when the remaining space no longer permits another placement.

pages.title: Crazy Plane Shooter
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Fight through side-scrolling air battles in Crazy Plane Shooter. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and fire with space or X. Three levels introduce different enemy types before the campaign reaches its final boss encounter.

pages.title: Mahjong 3D Candy
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match dessert-covered tiles in Mahjong 3D Candy. Inspect the three-dimensional arrangement and select identical candies or cookies to clear them. Keep finding usable pairs as you work to remove the remaining sweets from the puzzle.

pages.title: Drac & Franc
pages.creator: Brullworfel lab.
pages.description: Coordinate two famous monsters through a dungeon in Drac & Franc. Use separate keyboard controls for Dracula and Frankenstein, applying their different talents to the obstacles ahead. Their progress depends on cooperation rather than guiding only one character through the adventure.

pages.title: Aquapark Shark
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Ride a water slide toward the finish in Aquapark Shark. Help the small character complete the water-park course and aim for a better score. Keep working through the slide's changing route as the aquatic racing adventure continues.

pages.title: Fearless Rider
pages.creator: Real Gamer
pages.description: Drive a buggy across dangerous elevated courses in Fearless Rider. Avoid blades, hammers, and moving platforms while trying to finish quickly. Falling off the track or being hit can stop the run, so speed must be balanced with staying in control.

pages.title: Hover Shift
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Shift a hovercraft around deadly hazards in Hover Shift. Tap or swipe left and right when a gap opens, collecting coins and other items along the way. Keep choosing safe lanes quickly enough to preserve the ongoing flight.

pages.title: Dicez!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Compete against the computer in Dicez!. Roll dice, choose which results to keep, and reroll the others while building scoring combinations. Decide where to record the points as you try to finish with a higher total than the opposing player.

pages.title: Loot Heroes
pages.creator: Vitaly
pages.description: Explore infernal dungeons for equipment and rewards in Loot Heroes. Make your way through the underground areas and gather as much loot as possible. Repeat the journey for further finds, building the collection through successive dungeon expeditions.

pages.title: Keeper of the Grove 3
pages.creator: Y8.com
pages.description: Protect valuable gems in Keeper of the Grove 3. Place defensive turrets along the route to stop enemy creeps from carrying them away. Upgrade the defenders for tougher waves and call attacks early when you want the additional bonus for doing so.

pages.title: Mermaid New Year Celebration
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare an underwater party look in Mermaid New Year Celebration. Choose tail decorations and matching accessories for Ava, Mia, and Sofia. Coordinate the three characters' styles so the mermaids are ready to welcome the new year together.

pages.title: Hex A Mong
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Stay above the void in Hex A Mong. Run continuously across a three-layer arena whose hexagonal panels disappear shortly after you touch them. Keep finding fresh tiles as the floor vanishes, trying to remain on the platforms longer than the competition.

pages.title: Onnect Matching Puzzle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Clear paired fruit pictures in Onnect Matching Puzzle. Link identical tiles using a route of no more than three straight segments. Watch how pieces shift after removals and use the changing layout to locate further pairs and increase your score.

pages.title: 4 Colors Classic
pages.creator: QPLAZE LLC
pages.description: Empty your hand before the opposition in 4 Colors Classic. Play cards matching the current color or number, and use action cards to skip turns, reverse play, or force draws. Press the one-card button when needed to avoid a penalty near the finish.

pages.title: Rescue My Love
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Open safe routes through rescue scenes in Rescue My Love. Pull pins in a carefully chosen sequence, considering what each removal releases or allows to move. A wrong decision can spoil the attempt, so inspect the arrangement before trying again.

pages.title: Scrape and Guess
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Identify a concealed picture in Scrape and Guess. Rub away its gray covering to reveal clues, then use the available letters to enter the answer. Decide how much of the image you need to uncover before committing to a guess.

pages.title: Doctor Pets
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Care for sick kittens in Doctor Pets. Choose medical equipment and work through treatment tasks at the animal hospital. Attend to each patient's condition and complete the care sequence before moving on to another cat needing the veterinarian's help.

pages.title: Heroes of Match 3
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Help a displaced king reclaim his throne in Heroes of Match 3. Line up sweets to complete objectives and attack opponents through the matching system. Daily tasks provide bonuses, while tournaments let you compare your puzzle performance with other players.

pages.title: StickMan Jump Fun
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Keep a stick figure climbing in StickMan Jump Fun. Jump away from deadly obstacles and aim to gain more height with each attempt. The higher you manage to travel without colliding, the more you can add to the score.

pages.title: Fox Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color woodland character pictures in Fox Coloring Book. Choose shades and apply them with the available drawing and painting tools. Work through the outlined fox illustrations to create different palettes and individual versions of the animals.

pages.title: BFF Night Club Party Makeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help two friends prepare for an evening out in BFF Night Club Party Makeover. Shop for outfits and accessories, then complete spa and makeup activities. Coordinate Mia and Bella's finished looks so both are ready for the nightclub party.

pages.title: Mini Truck Driver Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive through dense road traffic in Mini Truck Driver Master. Tap to accelerate and slide to change lanes, aiming to travel farther without a collision. Earn coins to unlock other vehicles, including a tank, for later traffic-avoidance attempts.

pages.title: Jet Planes Jigsaw
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description: Rebuild aircraft pictures in Jet Planes Jigsaw. Select one of six images and an easy, medium, or hard arrangement, then drag pieces into their correct positions. Complete the selected plane image before trying another scene or difficulty.

pages.title: Impossible Bike Track Adventure 2k20
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Ride through hazardous courses in Impossible Bike Track Adventure 2k20. Handle a sports motorcycle across difficult tracks that test balance and steering. Different camera angles and routes let you assess each approach as you work on completing the stunt-driving challenge.

pages.title: Basket Random
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Score with one-button controls in Basket Random. Jump and contest the ball as the court, players, and ball change between rounds. Face the computer or another player, with the first side to reach five points winning the match.

pages.title: Ambulance Doctor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help three injured children in Ambulance Doctor. Follow the ambulance journey to the hospital and work through the treatment tasks for Amelia, Ava, and Aarush. Use the available tools to complete each patient's care and support their recovery.

pages.title: Caesar Salad
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Prepare a different dinner accompaniment in Caesar Salad. Follow the recipe activity and work through the ingredients and preparation steps shown by the game. The cooking sequence focuses on turning the selected components into a finished serving of the salad.

pages.title: Speed Car Racing Game 3D
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Compete in driving events in Speed Car Racing Game 3D. Race against the opposition while handling opportunities for drifting and stunts. The challenge centers on maintaining control of the car as you try to deliver a stronger performance through the competition.

pages.title: Sky Tower Higher
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Build upward with timed placements in Sky Tower Higher. Tap when the next section is in a useful position to add it to your tower. Keep aligning successive layers as you work toward constructing a taller stack.

pages.title: Aztec Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Help a father and daughter investigate ancient ruins in Aztec Adventure. Use the characters together to solve puzzles and cross the obstacles leading toward treasure. Separate controls let two players handle movement, jumping, hiding, and grenades during the expedition.

pages.title: Golem Armaggeddon
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Destroy approaching stone creatures in Golem Armaggeddon. Tap the golems to kill them and stop their advance through the play area. Keep identifying the next target as the challenge asks you to deal with the incoming attackers.

pages.title: Golem Slasher
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Cut down stone attackers in Golem Slasher. Slash the golems appearing in the play area and keep the threats from advancing unchecked. The action centers on reacting to the incoming creatures and removing them through your attacks.

pages.title: Horror Jungle Drive
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive through a threatening environment in Horror Jungle Drive. Follow the game's sequence of levels and keep the car under control as you explore. Use WASD for movement and toggle the headlights with L when the surroundings call for a different view.

pages.title: Pandas Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together bear illustrations in Pandas Puzzle. Six images offer four layouts, ranging from sixteen to one hundred pieces. Select a difficulty and arrange the scattered sections to complete the chosen panda picture before moving to another design.

pages.title: Archery Mania
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Practice placing arrows on target in Archery Mania. Use the mouse to aim and take shots through the game's archery levels. Begin with simpler targets and work on the accuracy needed to keep progressing through the shooting challenges.

pages.title: Tunnel Survival
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Steer through an endless passage in Tunnel Survival. Keep moving down the three-dimensional tunnel and avoid mistakes that end the attempt. The goal is to remain alive for as long as possible while navigating the route ahead.

pages.title: Crazy Monster Trucks Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare paired vehicle pictures in Crazy Monster Trucks Difference. Find five alterations between images that otherwise look nearly identical. Work through their small details and try to complete the search more quickly as you recognize the changes.

pages.title: Kawaii High School Teacher Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Design a character in Kawaii High School Teacher Dress Up. Choose skin tone, facial features, and makeup before selecting college uniforms or casual clothing. Eight backgrounds set different scenes for the teacher's finished outfits and styling choices.

pages.title: Halloween Painting Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rearrange seasonal artwork in Halloween Painting Slide. Pick one of three pictures and a puzzle mode, then restore the scene from its shuffled sections. Use the illustration's details to work out which pieces belong next to each other.

pages.title: Impossible Stunt Car Tracks 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Handle a performance vehicle high above the city in Impossible Stunt Car Tracks 3D. Choose a car and follow the elevated stunt route without falling. Ramps and difficult track sections test your steering as you work to complete the course.

pages.title: Candy Shop: Sweets Maker
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Repair a confectionery factory in Candy Shop: Sweets Maker. Rotate broken pipeline sections until the production route is connected again. Three modes and a succession of levels give you different arrangements to solve while restoring the sweets-making system.

pages.title: IceZag
pages.creator: sienar games
pages.description: Control repeated changes of direction in IceZag. Click to make the moving character follow a zigzag course and continue toward the next section. Keep timing the turns as you work on extending the run and improving your score.

pages.title: Mad Taxi Driver
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Keep a cab running in Mad Taxi Driver. Drive through the racing challenge while collecting fuel to extend the journey and nitro to support acceleration. Survival depends on preserving the vehicle's run as you continue gathering the supplies along the road.

pages.title: Perfect Slices 2
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Chop through slicing targets in Perfect Slices 2. Use the mouse to control the cutting action and work through the objects presented by the game. The activity focuses on placing repeated cuts and completing the next section of the slicing sequence.

pages.title: Archer 2 Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Defeat armed stick figures with a bow in Archer 2 Online. Aim each arrow carefully and shoot before the opponents can kill your character. Keep eliminating enemies as you work to extend the encounter and improve your performance.

pages.title: Puzzle Mania
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fit geometric pieces into the outlined area in Puzzle Mania. Compare each block's shape with the gray spaces, then move it into position. Complete the arrangement by placing every block without leaving the required area unfinished.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Saga
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Swap neighboring sweets in Sweet Candy Saga to form matching lines. Arrange at least three candies of one color horizontally or vertically to remove them. Keep scanning the board for exchanges that produce another useful group.

pages.title: 2 Dots Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Match a launched ball to a rotating target in 2 Dots Challenge. Fire when the matching target rotates into line with the shot. A mismatched hit or running out of shooting time ends the attempt.

pages.title: Dinosaurs Coloring Book
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Create colorful prehistoric scenes in Dinosaurs Coloring Book. Choose a dinosaur illustration and apply your preferred shades to its outlined areas. Experiment with different palettes to give each creature a finished appearance of your own.

pages.title: City Coach Bus Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Carry tourists along urban and highway routes in City Coach Bus Simulator. Take control of a passenger coach and handle the roads between stops. The transport simulation focuses on steering the bus through its mapped surroundings while completing the driving tasks.

pages.title: Coloring Kikker
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Paint storybook illustrations in Coloring Kikker. Choose a pencil and color, then draw freely, stay within outlines, or use automatic filling. The pictures feature Kikker and friends, with download and print options for both blank pages and completed artwork.

pages.title: Candy Super Match3
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Clear matching sweets in Candy Super Match3. Drag pieces into groups of at least three identical candies to remove them from the board. Continue looking for useful matches as the remaining arrangement changes with each successful group.

pages.title: Bubble Defence
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Defend against advancing bubble chains in Bubble Defence. Aim colored shots into the moving formation and create matches to remove its sections. Plan around the chain's path and keep clearing bubbles before the remaining ones reach the end.

pages.title: Retro Car Xtreme
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race from an overhead view in Retro Car Xtreme. Gather power-ups and choose useful moments to deploy them against rival drivers. Play alone or share the racing with a friend, both trying to reach the finish before the opposing cars.

pages.title: Pixel Runner
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Cross hazardous stages in Pixel Runner. Avoid traps and other deadly obstacles while gathering the three stars placed along the route. Reach the finish to complete the level, balancing progress through the course with collecting every available star.

pages.title: Air Force Fight
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight enemy aircraft in Air Force Fight. Play alone or with a second pilot and try to survive the opposing fighters. Campaign mode adds a twelve-level sequence where destroying enemies and collecting medals are part of completing the missions.

pages.title: Waterball
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Face a playful projectile fight in Waterball. Aim at characters as they appear and throw waterballs before they can hit you with their own shots. Intercept incoming projectiles, watch your supply, and reload when you need more ammunition for the next exchange.

pages.title: Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Remember revealed card pictures in Memory Challenge. Turn cards over, locate matching partners, and use earlier discoveries to avoid unnecessary guesses. Clear the arrangement to unlock another level and work on improving the results recorded for each memory puzzle.

pages.title: Candy Super Lines
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Arrange sweets into matching lines in Candy Super Lines. Select a candy and move it across an available route to an empty cell. Clear combinations to earn points and preserve space, continuing until the increasingly crowded board no longer allows useful moves.

pages.title: Jewel Pop
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match groups of three balloons in Jewel Pop. Look for identical colors and clear the required combinations as you progress through its levels. The puzzle uses colorful balloon pieces as the targets for each matching challenge.

pages.title: Kage Ninjas Revenge
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Take revenge on hostile machines in Kage Ninjas Revenge. Guide the ninja through levels filled with robots, rockets, spikes, and laser beams. Adjust your approach to each enemy and obstacle while working to clear every stage of the journey.

pages.title: Full Immersion
pages.creator: Enclave Games
pages.description: Search the ocean floor in Full Immersion. Guide a submarine deeper toward hidden treasure while collecting stars and helpful bonuses. Keep clear of mines along the descent so the expedition can continue toward its underwater goal.

pages.title: Monster Truck Driving
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drive to the flag in Monster Truck Driving. Accelerate, brake, and tilt the vehicle to handle the terrain, using the panning view to plan a route. Faster finishes earn stars that unlock additional themed trucks for later courses.

pages.title: The Battle
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Compare drawn cards in The Battle. Turn over the competing players' cards and let their values decide who wins the round. Gather the cards awarded through successful comparisons as you work toward overcoming the opposing deck in this traditional card contest.

pages.title: Monster Truck Soccer
pages.creator: TopSoft UG
pages.description: Play a physics-driven football match from a vehicle in Monster Truck Soccer. Bump into the opposing truck and push the ball toward its goal while protecting your side. Win the contest and explore the available hats for the trucks.

pages.title: Halloween Party Cake
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a holiday dessert in Halloween Party Cake. Help Ellie and Annie make a cake for the celebration, then choose dresses for them to wear. The activity combines the seasonal baking preparations with styling the two characters for their event.

pages.title: Princess First College Party
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Help new students settle in with Princess First College Party. Unpack belongings in the shared dorm room before preparing for an invitation to a party. Choose looks for the friends as they move from arriving on campus to their first college celebration.

pages.title: Jorge White Face
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help a traveler find his way home in Jorge White Face. Move Jorge through Costa Rican locations and complete the missions along the journey. Platforming jumps, piano challenges, and other varied activities form parts of the route back home.

pages.title: Celebrity Tailor Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design bridal gowns in Celebrity Tailor Shop. Help Rachel create three wedding dresses for a competition, choosing fabrics, colors, patterns, and frills. Try the finished designs on to assess their fit before the tailor presents them to the judges.

pages.title: Basketball Slide
pages.creator: BestGamesDevelopers
pages.description: Swipe a ball toward the hoop in Basketball Slide. Compete across four modes, collect stars, and unlock additional ball designs. Keep improving the direction of your shots as you compare results with friends and the wider rankings.

pages.title: Silly Ways to Die Party
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Support a musical performance in Silly Ways to Die Party. Activate the colored buttons with clicks, touches, or number keys one through four. Time the inputs to help the characters keep their show going through the rhythm challenge.

pages.title: Trivia Cracked
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Answer pop-culture questions in Trivia Cracked. Choose correct responses about subjects such as celebrities, cars, logos, and cartoons. Work through the quiz and test how accurately you can recognize the people, brands, and images it presents.

pages.title: Bomb It
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Defeat rivals with explosives in Bomb It. Place bombs through randomly arranged levels and use their blasts to eliminate opponents. Keep your own character clear of the danger while working out where the next explosion will be useful.

pages.title: Princesses At Masquerade
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Create formal costumes in Princesses At Masquerade. Dress the princesses for the event by combining clothing colors and textures, then add accessories to personalize each look. Coordinate the available pieces into finished outfits suited to the celebration.
